_purpose: Fixed-date national and Maharashtra state holidays used by the crowd model. MOVABLE religious festivals (Ganesh Chaturthi, Krishna Janmashtami, etc.) are NOT listed here — they are computed from panchang by the engine, per the brief ('do not rely on 2027 school calendars').
_status: Fixed-date entries below are stable year-on-year. The full GAZETTED 2027 holiday list (including movable and state-declared holidays) is not yet published — reconcile when released (UNVERIFIED.md #15).

fixed_date_holidays_2027.note: Falls ~2 weeks after the first Amrit Snan; relevant to the Aug bathing window.

movable_festivals_note: Ganesh Chaturthi (Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi) falls in early-mid September 2027 and is a MAJOR crowd amplifier in Maharashtra near the third Amrit Snan. Its exact date is computed by the engine, not hard-coded here. Krishna Janmashtami, Nag Panchami, etc. likewise come from the engine.
